question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amt_usd) DESC) AS rn
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
max_rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) AS max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_name,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_rep_sales mrs ON rs.region_name = mrs.region_name AND rs.rep_total_sales = mrs.max_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.num_orders,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(tr.rep_total_sales, 2) AS sales_rep_total_sales
FROM region_sales rs
JOIN top_reps tr ON rs.region_name = tr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name, tr.sales_rep_name;
